settings.title: Settings
settings.fsListView: Default to list view in file explorer

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: Click a trigger to rebind it (Escape cancels). "app"-type actions fire an internal function (some don't have a real one yet); "shell"-type actions send the text as a command to the active terminal tab.
shortcuts.deleteMessage: Delete the "{trigger}" shortcut? This cannot be undone.

mediaPlayer.hint: Local playback — the file is streamed straight from disk, never fully loaded into memory.

sysinfo.title: System
sysinfo.uptimeTooltip: How long the PC has been running without restarting
sysinfo.swapTooltip: Disk-backed virtual memory Windows uses once RAM fills up — slower than real RAM

hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.coresTooltip: Physical: real compute chips. Logical: includes Hyper-Threading/SMT virtual cores

cpu.title: CPU per core
cpu.averageTooltip: Average of all cores — last {count} samples
cpu.frequencyTooltip: Current average clock speed across cores, in megahertz
cpu.temperatureTooltip: General system temperature sensor (Windows doesn't always expose a per-CPU sensor)

gpu.vramTooltip: Dedicated GPU memory — separate from system RAM
gpu.loadStatsTooltip: Calculated over the history shown in the load chart
gpu.tempStatsTooltip: Calculated over the history shown in the temperature chart

toplist.title: Processes
toplist.pidTooltip: Unique identifier Windows assigns to each process
toplist.name: Name

netstat.title: Network
netstat.externalIpTooltip: The IP the rest of the internet sees you as (not your local network one)
netstat.locationTooltip: Approximate location tied to your external IP, not your exact location
netstat.ispTooltip: Internet provider (organization that owns your external IP)
netstat.localIpTooltip: Your IP within the local network (WiFi/Ethernet), used by other devices at home/office to see you
netstat.pingTooltip: Round-trip time of a network packet, in milliseconds — lower is better
netstat.connectionsTooltip: Real TCP connections to a remote server — doesn't include programs only listening locally
netstat.moreHint: +{count} more — click the title to see all

conninfo.title: Network traffic
conninfo.downloadTooltip: Download speed (data coming into your PC) across all your network interfaces combined
conninfo.uploadTooltip: Upload speed (data leaving your PC) across all your network interfaces combined

globe.title: Globe
globe.subtitle: Global network map
globe.endpointTooltip: Approximate location tied to your external IP
globe.webglUnavailable: Couldn't start 3D rendering on this machine (WebGL unavailable)
globe.offline: Offline — couldn't geolocate your external IP
globe.connectionsHint: {count} active connection(s) plotted on the map
globe.enableHint: Enable "Experimental 3D globe features" in Settings to see your active connections on the map
globe.dragHint: Drag to rotate the globe — auto-rotation resumes on its own

filesystem.goUp: Go up to the parent folder
filesystem.toggleView: Toggle between icon view and list view
filesystem.toggleDotfiles: Show or hide files starting with a dot (hidden by Unix convention)
